cases.initial_error: APB ACCESS completion leaves PSEL/PENABLE asserted for one extra cycle; VIP penable_after_psel error in address_data.
cases.changed_logic: Final edit deasserts PSEL and PENABLE on PREADY completion and changes response/launch logic.
cases.remaining_error: s_awready includes !w_have. With W accepted before AW, w_have blocks AW and neither half can clear until a write launches. Final private and held-out strobe_cross_early reject AXI acceptance exceeding 16 cycles.
cases.interpretation: One issue corrected but independent-handshake error retained; both public tests were spent on identical initial candidate. Final edit had no public retest. Attribution combines actual verifier findings and source inspection, not model internal reasoning.

cases.remaining_error: AWREADY/WREADY include !cur_write. cur_write remains 1 after a completed write and is cleared only by reset/read launch, blocking consecutive writes. Public post-hoc, private and held-out write_accumulate report AXI acceptance exceeding 16 cycles.
cases.interpretation: Real RTL failure without any test exposure. This trial cannot show diagnostic feedback effectiveness.

cases.initial_error: Compiler reported psel_r and penable_r undeclared at continuous assignments; declarations occurred later in the source.
cases.changed_logic: Moves psel_r/penable_r declarations ahead of uses and rewrites intermediate launch/ready expressions.
cases.final_result: Private and held-out 22 cases PASS; public 17 cases PASS.
cases.interpretation: Real edit after category-level compile feedback. Original compiler errors were not sent to the solver. One successful recovery does not establish a causal advantage over C.

cases.remaining_error: Write launch requires !is_write && aw_full && w_full, but is_write remains 1 after a completed write. The next write halves can be accepted but APB cannot launch. Public post-hoc, private and held-out write_accumulate fail APB launch exceeding 16 cycles.
cases.interpretation: Real no-feedback RTL error: stale transaction-direction state blocks the next same-direction transaction. Similar error family to r04-E, at launch rather than AXI acceptance.

cases.remaining_error: Both AWREADY and WREADY require !aw_have && !w_have. Acceptance of either half inhibits the other, so only simultaneous AW/W can complete. Final private and held-out strobe_cross_early reject AXI acceptance beyond 16 cycles.
cases.interpretation: First candidate passed all 17 public cases in post-submit offline measurement. The second revision added mutual AW/W gating, introducing an independent-handshake regression. Different source hashes: this is not a same-candidate public-PASS/private-FAIL observation.

cases.remaining_error: apb_active is declared as a single logic bit but represents states 0/1/2. Assigning 2 truncates to 0; PENABLE (apb_active == 2) never asserts. Public, private and held-out address_data detect APB penable_after_psel.
cases.interpretation: Valid action protocol and actual FAIL exposure, but no repair attempted; model submits unchanged failing RTL with one test still available.

feedback_visible_to_agent.diagnostic: AXI request acceptance exceeded the 16-cycle limit.
AXI request acceptance exceeded the 16-cycle limit.

cases.remaining_error: AWREADY and WREADY share idle, which requires both half-buffer-valid bits clear. Accepting either half disables acceptance of the other; non-simultaneous write halves deadlock. Public channel_gaps and final private/held-out strobe_cross_early confirm acceptance beyond 16 cycles.
cases.interpretation: Detailed functional feedback really delivered twice, including acceptance bound; no subsequent edit. Exposure is not evidence of a repair attempt.

cases.remaining_error: s_bvalid assignment simplifies to bpend && !s_bready, while bpend clears when BREADY is high independently of BVALID. With early BREADY, no write response is presented. Private/held-out address_data reject AXI response beyond 16 cycles.
cases.interpretation: Two edits without functional feedback; first confirmed final error is response production/handshake, not simulator infrastructure timeout.

cases.initial_error: s_arvalid_tmp and have_ar used before declaration in continuous assignments; compiler IND errors.
cases.changed_logic: Declares have_ar before assignments; removes the forward-declared s_arvalid_tmp alias and uses !have_ar directly.
cases.interpretation: Second category-level compile-feedback recovery in E. No raw compiler error text was delivered.
